name.ja: ＨＧ 1/144 高機動型ザク 地上用 (ウォルド機)
name.en: HG 1/144 High Mobility Type Zaku Ground Use (Waldo Machine)

description.ja: ― 南 十 字 星 （ サ ザ ン ク ロ ス） の 狩 人 ―
description.en: - Hunter of the Southern Cross -

description.ja: 映画『機動戦士ガンダム ククルス・ドアンの島』より、“褐色のサザンクロス隊”副隊長ウォルド・レンが搭乗する
description.en: From the movie "Mobile Suit Gundam Cucurrus Doan's Island ", Waldo Wren, the vice-captain of the " Brown Southern Cross", will be on board.

description.ja: 高機動型ザク 地上用がＨＧシリーズに登場。一般機の頭部と武装類が新規で付属。
description.en: High mobility type Zaku ground version now available in the HG series. General machine head and weapons are newly included.

description.ja: 特徴的な迷彩模様のカラーリングは成形色と水転写式デカールで再現。ジオン公国軍サザンクロス隊の部隊章やコーションマーク等を収録。
description.en: The characteristic camouflage pattern coloring is reproduced with molded colors and water transfer decals. Contains unit insignia and caution marks of the Zeon Principality Army Southern Cross Corps.

description.ja: ●　一般機の頭部形状を再現！
description.en: ● Reproduce the head shape of a general machine!

description.ja: 頭部ブレードアンテナを装備していない一般機の頭部が新規で付属。
description.en: A new head of a general machine that is not equipped with a head blade antenna is included.

description.ja: 特徴的なシールドに加え、ホバー走行を可能にする腰部・脚部形状まで精密に再現。
description.en: In addition to the characteristic seal, the shape of the waist and legs that enable hovering are precisely reproduced.

description.ja: ●　膝部可動ギミック搭載
description.en: ● Equipped with a movable knee gimmick

description.ja: 脚部関節には引き出しギミックを搭載。膝曲げ時の可動域が大幅に向上。
description.en: The leg joints are equipped with a drawer gimmick. The range of motion when bending the knee is greatly improved.

description.ja: ●　遠距離戦闘に特化した武装類を新規パーツで再現
description.en: ● Weapons specialized for long-distance combat are reproduced with new parts.

description.ja: 対艦ライフル・ショーティー
description.en: anti-ship rifle shorty

description.ja: 対艦ライフルをショートバレル化させた射撃武装を新規立体化。弾倉は銃本体から着脱が可能！
description.en: A new three-dimensional shooting armament with a short barrel anti-ship rifle. The magazine can be attached and detached from the gun body!

description.ja: また、予備弾倉はシールドに装着可能。
description.en: In addition, a spare magazine can be attached to the Seal.

description.ja: ライフルは臀部マウントラックを展開し、専用のジョイントパーツを用いる事でマウント可能。
description.en: The rifle can be mounted by expanding the hip mount rack and using special joint parts.

description.ja: 対艦ライフル
description.en: anti-ship rifle

description.ja: モロッコ戦線にて使用していたロングバレルの対艦ライフルが付属。
description.en: A long barrel anti-ship rifle used on the Moroccan front is included.

description.ja: ヒート・ホーク
description.en: heat hawk

description.ja: 近接武器としてヒート・ホークが付属。
description.en: A heat hawk is included as a melee weapon.

description.ja: ●　アクションベース用ジョイントパーツやポージングの幅を広げる左平手パーツが付属。
description.en: ● Comes with joint parts for action base and left palm part to expand the range of poses.

description.ja: ●　迷彩模様を成形色と水転写式デカールで再現
description.en: ● Reproduce the camouflage pattern with molded colors and water transfer decals

description.ja: ウォルド機の迷彩パターンを成形色と水転写式デカールで再現。塗装なしで印象的な迷彩模様を再現可能。
description.en: The camouflage pattern of the Wold machine is reproduced with molded colors and water transfer decals. Impressive camouflage patterns can be reproduced without painting.

description.ja: ジオン公国軍サザンクロス隊の部隊章やコーションマーク等を収録。
description.en: Contains unit insignia and caution marks of the Zeon Principality Army Southern Cross Corps.

description.ja: 付属武装：対艦ライフル・ショーティー / 対艦ライフル / ヒート・ホーク
description.en: Attached weapons: Anti-ship rifle Shorty / Anti-ship rifle / Heat Hawk
